About broadcasts

A Periscope broadcast is a live video stream. Viewers can engage directly with the broadcaster and other viewers through the use of real time commenting and hearts. A stream can be as short or as long as you want.
Broadcasts are by default public and visible to everyone on our platform. You can, however, opt to
and make it visible to a select group of viewers.
